summary: The comment opposes the removal of E-Rate funding, emphasizing the importance of internet access for students, staff, libraries, and individuals in need. It argues that the funding should be used to serve underfunded areas rather than being diverted to unapproved wars and ballrooms. The comment highlights the criminal nature of removing access to the internet for those who rely on it for communication, information, and services.

claims.argument: Removing funding would eliminate access to internet services for underfunded and underserved areas
claims.evidence_quote: Stop funding un-approved wars and un-approved ballrooms and instead give our kids and libraries funds to assure they have basic access to the very system that keeps them connected to their nation.

filer_raw: Amy Smith | Danny Goor | Aiden Goor
